descriptions.en: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
descriptions.zh: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。

descriptions.en: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
descriptions.zh: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是 Prime 的。Lavos 是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。

descriptions.en: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
descriptions.zh: 利用反物质。 Nova 使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。

descriptions.en: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Nova Prime 以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ELYTRON）这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。

descriptions.en: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA PRIME）第一架曲翼原型的强化机型，已将其设计为到理论上的极限状态。

descriptions.en: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA）这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。

descriptions.en: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ITZAL）专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。

descriptions.en: Transform into a winged guardian.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMESHA）化身成一名飞翼守护者。

descriptions.en: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。

descriptions.en: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Banshee Prime 以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
descriptions.zh: Octavia 将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。

descriptions.en: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 女音乐家 Octavia，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。

descriptions.en: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
descriptions.zh: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。

descriptions.en: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
descriptions.zh: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。Atlas 可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。

descriptions.en: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
descriptions.zh: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。

descriptions.en: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
descriptions.zh: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。

descriptions.en: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
descriptions.zh: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。

descriptions.en: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
descriptions.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。

descriptions.en: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
descriptions.zh: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。Mesa 是该领域最快的拔枪手。

descriptions.en: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
descriptions.zh: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。Dagath 的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。

descriptions.en: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
descriptions.zh: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。Uriel 用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。

descriptions.en: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
descriptions.zh: Grendel 将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。

descriptions.en: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
descriptions.zh: 原始。永不饱足。Grendel Prime 吞食所有反抗他的人。

descriptions.en: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 与元素紧密结合并发动无尽毁灭之力的 Chroma Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
descriptions.zh: 释放龙之力量。Chroma 使用火焰、电击、毒素和冰冻元素来造成高伤害，同时保持生存能力。以愤怒为翼，翱翔吧。

descriptions.en: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.
descriptions.zh: Narin 如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。

descriptions.en: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
descriptions.zh: 操纵烈焰之力。Ember 的火焰会造成很高的伤害。即使战斗进入白热化时，她仍能保持冷静的头脑。

descriptions.en: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Ember Prime 具有像 Ember 一样肆意破坏的潜力，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VOIDRIG）虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。

descriptions.en: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BONEWIDOW）这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。

descriptions.en: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur 是战士精神的缩影。他炉火纯青的剑术可造成高额伤害。他是卓越武学的化身。

descriptions.en: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur Prime 是机动性与攻击性的象征，并拥有与 Excalibur 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
descriptions.zh: 来自长夜暗影中的新型 Excalibur。

descriptions.en: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
descriptions.zh: Titania 仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。

descriptions.en: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
descriptions.zh: 诱人而又令人恐惧，这就是 Titania 的终极形态。

descriptions.en: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost's attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
descriptions.zh: 当 Frost 踏上战场时，敌人会感到一阵寒意。 Frost 的攻击可以提供群体控制、保护目标，并提高生存力。驾驭刺骨的冰雪之力。

descriptions.en: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Frost Prime 拥有与 Frost 一样的急冻技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
descriptions.zh: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：Cyte-09。

descriptions.en: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
descriptions.zh: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。Garuda 以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。

descriptions.en: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
descriptions.zh: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。

descriptions.en: The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.
descriptions.zh: 水晶堡垒拔地而起。Citrine Prime 散发着令人着迷的夺目光彩，她那璀璨的宝石镶嵌在精美的金丝花纹中。

descriptions.en: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
descriptions.zh: 凝视这位水晶卫士。Citrine 的水晶可以在战场上支持盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。

descriptions.en: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
descriptions.zh: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士 Gara 的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。

descriptions.en: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
descriptions.zh: Gara 以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。Gara 的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。

descriptions.en: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
descriptions.zh: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，Gyre 的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。

descriptions.en: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
descriptions.zh: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与 Gyre Prime 一起舞向永恒。

descriptions.en: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
descriptions.zh: Mirage 的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。

descriptions.en: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 用这位精通幻术和破坏的金色大师来扰乱对手吧。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
descriptions.zh: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。

descriptions.en: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
descriptions.zh: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。

descriptions.en: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
descriptions.zh: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。

descriptions.en: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
descriptions.zh: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的瘟疫之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。

descriptions.en: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
descriptions.zh: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者 Follie 赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。

descriptions.en: Strength is Hildryn's virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
descriptions.zh: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。

descriptions.en: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
descriptions.zh: Hildryn Prime 证明了权力是纪律的回报。

descriptions.en: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。

descriptions.en: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Nyx Prime 来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
descriptions.zh: Khora 有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。

descriptions.en: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
descriptions.zh: 女能手和怪物的默契配合。镀金女猎手与她忠诚的库娃——薇娜丽，以她们的意志统治着战场。

descriptions.en: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
descriptions.zh: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。

descriptions.en: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
descriptions.zh: Loki 精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。

descriptions.en: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 混淆、误导与破坏是 Loki Prime 的代名词。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
descriptions.zh: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。Mag 通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。

descriptions.en: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 精巧的 Mag Prime 拥有与 Mag 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
descriptions.zh: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。 Limbo 通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。

descriptions.en: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
descriptions.zh: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。

descriptions.en: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
descriptions.zh: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。

descriptions.en: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
descriptions.zh: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。

descriptions.en: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
descriptions.zh: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。

descriptions.en: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
descriptions.zh: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。 Ash 擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。

descriptions.en: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
descriptions.zh: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里

descriptions.en: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
descriptions.zh: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。

descriptions.en: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
descriptions.zh: 看这位双父之女。Protea Prime 曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承 Tenno 的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。

descriptions.en: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
descriptions.zh: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。

descriptions.en: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
descriptions.zh: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。

descriptions.en: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
descriptions.zh: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。

descriptions.en: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
descriptions.zh: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。

descriptions.en: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
descriptions.zh: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。

descriptions.en: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
descriptions.zh: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

descriptions.en: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
descriptions.zh: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。

descriptions.en: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
descriptions.zh: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。

descriptions.en: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
descriptions.zh: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。

descriptions.en: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
descriptions.zh: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。

descriptions.en: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
descriptions.zh: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。 Ivara 善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。

descriptions.en: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
descriptions.zh: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的 Revenant，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。

descriptions.en: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
descriptions.zh: 迷失者之崛起。使用 Revenant Prime 的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。

descriptions.en: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。

descriptions.en: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使 RHINO 地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。

descriptions.en: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
descriptions.zh: 以水银打造的外型。Gauss Prime 不容失败。

descriptions.en: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
descriptions.zh: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。Gauss 速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。

descriptions.en: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把 Inaros 带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
descriptions.zh: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。

descriptions.en: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
descriptions.zh: 剧毒是 Saryn 的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对 Saryn 来说，毒液是一种美德。

descriptions.en: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一朵隐藏着致命花蜜的金花。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
descriptions.zh: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。

descriptions.en: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
descriptions.zh: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与 Sentient 形态在 Caliban 身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。

descriptions.en: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
descriptions.zh: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

descriptions.en: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
descriptions.zh: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

descriptions.en: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
descriptions.zh: 魅力四射的 Temple，手持他的感染吉他：丽兹，用强力的和弦点燃了革命的火焰。

descriptions.en: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
descriptions.zh: 掌控风之力量。Zephyr 的旋风技能可以保护她、造成高伤害并提供群体控制。她从上方俯冲而下，留下一条毁灭之路。

descriptions.en: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.
descriptions.zh: 用这只富有破坏力的金色小鸟飞向天空。

descriptions.en: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
descriptions.zh: Vauban 是创新技术的典范。他会通过巧妙的部署来对敌人造成群体控制。他的坚韧和专注使他令敌人生畏。

descriptions.en: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.
descriptions.zh: 使用这位镀金的战术大师来将战场转变成你的武器吧！该战甲拥有​​着特化过的 MOD 极性槽来提供更佳的自定可能性。

descriptions.en: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
descriptions.zh: Trinity 体现了救赎与治愈。她非凡的治疗技能可为队友提供强力支持。被他人破坏之处，她可治愈。

descriptions.en: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Trinity Prime 操控强大的治愈能力，成为捍卫友军的壁垒。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
descriptions.zh: 电流在 Volt 身上涌动。他的攻击可造成高额伤害，并震慑敌人。

descriptions.en: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，Volt Prime 拥有与 Volt 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
descriptions.zh: 辉煌与凶猛在 Voruna Prime 身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。

descriptions.en: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
descriptions.zh: 四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。

descriptions.en: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
descriptions.zh: Wisp 游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。

descriptions.en: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
descriptions.zh: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。

descriptions.en: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
descriptions.zh: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。

descriptions.en: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
descriptions.zh: Sevagoth 不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。

descriptions.en: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
descriptions.zh: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。

descriptions.en: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
descriptions.zh: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。

descriptions.en: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
descriptions.zh: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。

descriptions.en: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
descriptions.zh: Equinox 从白昼与黑夜的边缘崛起。她的白昼形态提供攻击支援，她的黑夜形态提供防御支援。她在白昼与黑夜之间来回游走。
